expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; const nav = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(a => (a.textContent||'').includes('Knowledge base')); return JSON.stringify({ navEntry: nav, hero: t.includes('Everything about using Constellation'), sectionCount: (t.match(/article(s)?/g)||[]).length, hasWelcome: t.includes('Welcome to Constellation'), hasTroubleshooting: t.includes('Troubleshooting'), hasSearchBox: !!document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="Search"]') }); })()

(() => { const input = document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="Search"]'); if (!input) return 'no search'; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'approval gate'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'typed'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return JSON.stringify({ results: t.includes('Approval gate'), resultCount: (t.match(/result/g)||[]).length, hasQuickstart: t.includes('Quick start') }); })()
(() => { const a = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).find(x => (x.getAttribute('href')||'').includes('/docs/autonomous-watch')); if (!a) return 'no link'; a.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
